# Non-expert crowds on hard questions (generated by scripts/run_hard_crowds.py)

AUC against gold that does not come from the crowd. Differences are paired bootstraps (2000 resamples) against Dawid-Skene on 5 quantile bins.

## Deepfake videos (Groh et al. 2022), 0-100 confidence it is fake

54 items (27 positive), 304 raters, median 114 ratings per item and 20 per rater.

### 1. Individuals as raters (sparse)

Two raters share a median of 7 items and no pair shares 20 or more (max 14), so FUSE has no moments to estimate here; baselines only.

| Method | AUC | AUC vs D&S 5 bins (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|
| Majority vote (median split) | 91.1 | +3.4 [-1.6, +9.1] |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 90.7 | +3.0 [-1.4, +8.4] |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 87.7 |  |
| Mean z-score | 89.2 | +1.5 [-2.7, +5.8] |
| Crowd mean (raw scores) | 90.0 | +2.3 [-2.1, +7.1] |

### 2. Demographic groups as raters (dense)

12 groups (12-59 people each), mean score per group and item.

| Method | AUC | AUC vs D&S 5 bins (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|
| Majority vote (median split) | 90.8 | +0.3 [-2.2, +3.3] |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 91.7 | +1.2 [-1.6, +4.6] |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 90.5 |  |
| Mean z-score | 91.4 | +0.8 [-1.0, +3.6] |
| FUSE logistic (paper) | 92.5 | +1.9 [+0.0, +5.1] |
| FUSE triplet posterior (paper) | 90.7 | +0.2 [-4.2, +4.3] |
| FUSE product posterior | 89.9 | -0.6 [-4.4, +2.4] |

Within-class correlation between group columns: 0.47.

### 3. Demographic vs. random groups of the same sizes

Random: mean over 20 draws (in brackets, the share of draws where the method beats D&S 5 bins). Within-class correlation, random groups: 0.44.

| Method | Demographic groups | Random groups | FUSE/other minus D&S 5 bins: demographic | random |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Majority vote (median split) | 90.8 | 89.1 (20%) | +0.3 | -1.8 |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 91.7 | 89.3 (20%) | +1.2 | -1.6 |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 90.5 | 90.9 (0%) | +0.0 | +0.0 |
| Mean z-score | 91.4 | 90.1 (25%) | +0.8 | -0.8 |
| FUSE logistic (paper) | 92.5 | 90.6 (40%) | +1.9 | -0.3 |
| FUSE triplet posterior (paper) | 90.7 | 89.9 (40%) | +0.2 | -0.9 |
| FUSE product posterior | 89.9 | 89.6 (35%) | -0.6 | -1.2 |

## News articles (Allen et al. 2021), 1-7 accuracy ratings vs. fact-checkers

189 items (82 positive), 1128 raters, median 98 ratings per item and 17 per rater.

### 1. Individuals as raters (sparse)

Two raters share a median of 1 items and no pair shares 20 or more (max 16), so FUSE has no moments to estimate here; baselines only.

| Method | AUC | AUC vs D&S 5 bins (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|
| Majority vote (median split) | 89.2 | +5.4 [+2.5, +8.5] |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 88.7 | +4.9 [+2.0, +7.9] |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 83.8 |  |
| Mean z-score | 88.5 | +4.7 [+2.0, +7.7] |
| Crowd mean (raw scores) | 90.1 | +6.3 [+3.3, +9.7] |

### 2. Demographic groups as raters (dense)

10 groups (61-146 people each), mean score per group and item.

| Method | AUC | AUC vs D&S 5 bins (95% CI) |
|---|---:|---|
| Majority vote (median split) | 89.9 | -0.4 [-2.4, +1.7] |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 90.2 | -0.0 [-1.7, +1.7] |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 90.3 |  |
| Mean z-score | 91.2 | +0.9 [-0.5, +2.5] |
| FUSE logistic (paper) | 90.9 | +0.6 [-0.5, +1.9] |
| FUSE triplet posterior (paper) | 90.1 | -0.1 [-2.0, +1.7] |
| FUSE product posterior | 89.9 | -0.4 [-2.4, +1.7] |

Within-class correlation between group columns: 0.34 (same political side 0.45, opposite sides 0.23).

### 3. Demographic vs. random groups of the same sizes

Random: mean over 20 draws (in brackets, the share of draws where the method beats D&S 5 bins). Within-class correlation, random groups: 0.41.

| Method | Demographic groups | Random groups | FUSE/other minus D&S 5 bins: demographic | random |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| Majority vote (median split) | 89.9 | 89.5 (15%) | -0.4 | -0.5 |
| Dawid-Skene (median split) | 90.2 | 89.6 (25%) | -0.0 | -0.4 |
| Dawid-Skene (5 bins) | 90.3 | 90.0 (0%) | +0.0 | +0.0 |
| Mean z-score | 91.2 | 90.1 (55%) | +0.9 | +0.1 |
| FUSE logistic (paper) | 90.9 | 90.0 (55%) | +0.6 | +0.0 |
| FUSE triplet posterior (paper) | 90.1 | 88.6 (5%) | -0.1 | -1.5 |
| FUSE product posterior | 89.9 | 88.3 (15%) | -0.4 | -1.7 |
